summary: Verified all 3 Try-On page bug fixes via Playwright against production URL. Login with tryon_test@example.com succeeded. Bug 1 (remove/retake photo): both data-testid=remove-photo-button and data-testid=retake-photo appear after upload, and clicking either clears photo and re-shows upload controls. Bug 2 (one item per category): 7 slots (top/bottom/dress/jacket/shoes/jewelry/accessory) all present; picking two different top items results in only the SECOND being active (border-foreground on second, not first), confirming single-pick-per-category enforcement; switching to slot-bottom and picking retains the top slot independently. Bug 3 (3-step stepper): step-1/2/3 buttons visible, 'Step 1 · Photo' heading on load, next-to-garments moves to 'Step 2 · Outfit', back-to-photo returns to step 1, tryon-generate-button transitions to step 3 and produces a completed MockDevelopmentAdapter result. 2D single-view placeholder banner visible on result panel. Adapter badge shows 'MockDevelopmentAdapter'. Result includes photo_file_id and result_file_id (PrivateImage rendered).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In TryOnPage.jsx line 261-267, the inner element for clear-slot uses a <span> with onClick nested inside a <button> (invalid HTML - button-in-button semantics). Consider changing outer to div or inner to a real button with type='button' + stopPropagation.
Minor: Step 2 panel shows 'Step 3 · Adapter' overline within step 2 UI (line 307) which is confusing labeling - adapter selection is part of step 2 in the stepper but overline says Step 3.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 Try-On bug fixes verified working on production URL. Only backend adapter tested is mock (per request). HF real adapter path was explicitly out of scope.
